name: enable_module
label: Enable Module
help_text: When off, the module outputs nothing. Use to keep the module in the page flow but hide it from view.

name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Replaces the auto-generated module ID used in HTML and for CSS/JS targeting. Leave blank to use the default.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Additional CSS classes for styling this module.

name: heading_items
label: Headings
help_text: Add one or more headings. Each heading can have its own size, color, alignment, and responsive display overrides.

children.name: heading_text
children.label: Heading
children.help_text: Main heading text. Plain text or raw HTML tags (e.g. strong, em, span).

children.name: heading_size
children.label: Size
children.help_text: HTML heading level (h1–h6). Use Display Size to control how large it looks.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Controls how large the heading appears. Independent of the HTML heading level (Size).

children.name: heading_color
children.label: Color
children.help_text: Theme or custom color for this heading. Auto inherits from context.

children.name: heading_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Color is set to Custom.

children.name: heading_align
children.label: Align
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment of the heading from 992px and up. Auto inherits from section or theme. Use Override Text Alignment (Tablet/Mobile) to set alignment for smaller screens.

children.name: heading_md_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_md_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: heading_md_display_size_override
children.label: Override Tablet Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_display_size_override
children.label: Override Mobile Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_padding_override
children.label: Override Padding
children.help_text: Enable to override the theme's default padding for this heading. When enabled, you can set custom top and bottom padding values. When disabled, padding is controlled by the theme's display size setting.

children.name: heading_padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Top padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Bottom padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_class
children.label: CSS Class
children.help_text: Additional CSS class(es) for this element. Space-separated.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video. Requires Marketing Video in your HubSpot account.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop. Works on all HubSpot tiers (no Video Management required).

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources. For autoplay as background, use a URL that includes autoplay and muted if supported.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.

children.name: module_settings
children.label: Module Settings
children.help_text: Module height, vertical alignment, and spacing. Height cascades from XL unless overridden; vertical alignment defaults to middle with per-breakpoint overrides.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Adjust margins and padding for the module wrapper. Margin creates space between modules; padding creates space around the module content. When no padding is set, use no padding (do not default to 25px). When the module has multiple spacing fields (e.g. Text Box Padding), each applies to its intended target only — see MODULE-SETTINGS-BACKGROUND-STANDARD §1.

children.name: max_module_width
children.label: Max Module Width
children.help_text: Default, Small, Large: Use values from Global theme styles > Containers. Full Width: Content spans the full screen. Custom: Enter a specific pixel value (600–2400).

children.name: max_module_width_custom
children.label: Max Module Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width in pixels when Custom is selected above.

children.name: module_height_xl_group
children.label: XL Module Height
children.help_text: Height settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: module_height_xl_mode
children.label: Minimum Height
children.help_text: Default: no minimum height (content dictates height). Custom Height: set a pixel value. Full Screen: 100vh minus header.

children.name: module_height_xl
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels. Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: vertical_align_xl
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment of content within the module at XL breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_lg_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_lg
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses XL value.

children.name: module_height_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_md_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_md
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_md
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_height_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_sm_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_sm
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_sm
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_background_settings
children.label: Module Background Settings
children.help_text: Configure the module background: Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, Image, or Video. All background styling (colors, gradient, image, and for Video the overlay and base color) is in this Style tab. When Video is selected, choose the video source only in the Content tab (Module Background Video).

children.name: background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Choose the type of background: Theme Color, Custom Color (hex with opacity), Gradient, Image, or Video. When Video is selected, overlay and base color appear here; choose the video source and poster in the Content tab under Module Background Video.

children.name: background_color_overlay_video
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the video. Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: background_base_color_video
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the video (fallback or before video loads). Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: video_autoplay
children.label: Autoplay
children.help_text: Start playing when the page loads (recommended for background video).

children.name: video_loop
children.label: Loop
children.help_text: Restart the video when it ends.

children.name: video_muted
children.label: Muted
children.help_text: Play without sound (required for autoplay in most browsers).

children.name: video_plays_inline
children.label: Plays inline
children.help_text: Play inline on mobile instead of fullscreen.

children.name: background_image_xl_group
children.label: XL Background Image
children.help_text: Background image settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: background_image_xl
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Fallback image for smaller breakpoints if not overridden. For retina quality: use 2× the display width (about 2400px at 1200px). Height can match your section—from very short to several hundred pixels—and Background Position helps with focal point.

children.name: background_position_xl
children.label: Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_xl
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_xl
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image to adjust contrast for text.

children.name: background_base_color_xl
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image (fallback or for transparent areas).

children.name: background_image_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_lg_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_md_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md
children.label: Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_md
children.label: Tablet Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_md
children.label: Tablet Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_md
children.label: Tablet Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_md
children.label: Tablet Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_sm_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Theme Color is set to Custom.

children.name: background_custom
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Solid color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient colors and direction when Background Option is Gradient.
